nodes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

frames.label: L1 Frame 03

nodes.text: You do not need to fix your life tonight.

text: You do not need to fix your life tonight.

frames.label: L1 Frame 04

nodes.text: Maybe you opened this after a relapse. Maybe the last few days have been bad. Maybe nothing dramatic happened at all.
You are simply tired of ending up in the same place.

frames.label: L1 Frame 05

nodes.text: Good. That gives us somewhere to start.
For tonight, one decision is enough.

frames.label: L1 Frame 06

nodes.text: The mind likes to turn quitting into an enormous promise.

text: The mind likes to turn quitting into an enormous promise.

frames.label: L1 Frame 08

nodes.text: At midnight, those promises are almost useless. They ask a tired version of you to carry a future that has not happened yet.

text: At midnight, those promises are almost useless. They ask a tired version of you to carry a future that has not happened yet.

frames.label: L1 Frame 10

nodes.text: For the next few hours, the job is simple: do not relapse.

text: For the next few hours, the job is simple: do not relapse.

frames.label: L1 Frame 11

nodes.text: Not for the next three months.
Not even for the rest of the week.

text: Not for the next three months.

frames.label: L1 Frame 12

nodes.text: Tomorrow, we can work on the habit itself.
Tonight, make sure it does not get another round.

text: Tomorrow, we can work on the habit itself.

frames.label: L1 Frame 13

nodes.text: Go back to the last time it happened at night. Where were you before the searching started?

text: Go back to the last time it happened at night. Where were you before the searching started?

frames.label: L1 Frame 14

nodes.text: Maybe you were in bed with your phone. Maybe you could not sleep. Maybe you had a bad day and wanted something that would switch your head off for a while.

text: Maybe you were in bed with your phone. Maybe you could not sleep. Maybe you had a bad day and wanted something that would switch your head off for a while.

frames.label: L1 Frame 15

nodes.text: There is usually an earlier moment when stopping is cheap.
Before you are fully caught in it.

text: There is usually an earlier moment when stopping is cheap.
Before you are fully caught in it.

frames.label: L1 Frame 16

nodes.text: Where do most of your night-time relapses begin?
Pick the one that happens most.

text: Where do most of your night-time relapses begin?

frames.label: L1 Frame 17

nodes.text: An urge at midnight is much more convincing when the whole habit sits one thumb-movement away.

text: An urge at midnight is much more convincing when the whole habit sits one thumb-movement away.

frames.label: L1 Frame 18

nodes.text: If the phone is across the room, you have to stand up. If it is downstairs, you have to leave the bed.

text: If the phone is across the room, you have to stand up. If it is downstairs, you have to leave the bed.

frames.label: L1 Frame 19

nodes.text: If the laptop is closed and put away, you have to make another decision before anything happens.
That small gap matters. Do not spend willpower where distance will do the job.

text: If the laptop is closed and put away, you have to make another decision before anything happens.

frames.label: L1 Frame 20

nodes.text: Once you have done that, you are finished for today.

text: Once you have done that, you are finished for today.

frames.label: L1 Frame 21

nodes.text: No huge promise about the future.
No test of whether you are “strong enough.”

text: No huge promise about the future.

frames.label: L1 Frame 23

nodes.text: Set up tonight before you get tired. Use the option that matches where you sleep.
Done when you can’t reach your usual device from bed without standing up.

frames.label: L1 Frame 24

nodes.text: Set the alarm now. Charge the phone outside the room. Put a laptop or tablet in a closed bag, drawer, or cupboard away from the bed.
Put the device in a bag, locker, desk drawer, or fixed charging spot that you cannot reach while lying down.
Studio, sofa bed, or temporary space
Put the device at the farthest practical point from where you sleep: a kitchen counter, shelf, zipped bag, or other fixed place.
Set the alarm first. Put the phone across the room or outside it. Turn off non-essential notifications before you put it down.
